Loki 配置

auth_enabled: false

server:
  http_listen_port: 3100

schema_config:
  configs:
  - from: 2024-01-01
    store: boltdb-shipper
    object_store: filesystem
    schema: v11
    index:
      prefix: index_
      period: 24h

storage_config:
  boltdb:
    directory: /loki/index
  filesystem:
    directory: /loki/chunks

limits_config:
  reject_old_samples: true
  accept_old_samples: true

中级
